name: Isezaki Ema
source:
A girl who is earnest and inflexible. She is a hard-working girl who devotes herself to everything, from sports to committee, but because of her perfectionist nature, she does not tolerate a single mistake and always tries to correct them, which does not endear her to the other students. This makes her feel unappreciated for her hard work. 
While she heavily admires Inori who is excellent in many areas, she also see her as a rival to pursue, but she is still unable to surpass her.
As a member of the morals committee, she avoids romantic and obscene matters, but she has a healthy libido and is interested in them.
